run_pairwise_bleu_scoring: run the scoring script with --sys to compute pairwise BLEU over candidate hypotheses
run_multi_reference_bleu: run the scoring script with --ref and --sys to compute multi-reference BLEU scores
run_intra_reference_bleu: run the scoring script with --ref only to compute intra-reference pairwise and leave-one-out BLEU
compute_corpus_bleu: compute corpus-level BLEU score between a system output stream and reference streams using sacrebleu
compute_sentence_bleu: compute sentence-level BLEU score between a single hypothesis and reference with exponential smoothing
